title: Mac

our_entries.enemy_kind: Highroad blockade boss; Adventurer text puts him in "the cave leading to Blackspore Swamp" (2441990229)

our_entries.enemy_kind: Hooligan leader who blockaded the village.
location_evidence: A camp shielded by Gloam Artifacts, then "the cave leading to Blackspore Swamp" (2441990229). Also the boss of Highroad Hijinx (row on NPCs - Wilds).

our_entries.enemy_kind: Hooligan leader and boss of Highroad Hijinx (the same Mac is the Cobblestone Village blockade leader in the Adventurer line; "Mac Gravelfist" of the Sunstone Gateway, 3037238698, is a different person).
location_evidence: The hooligan camp in the hills above the high road.
